items.title: Cain, Abel, Seth, and Israel in Allegorical Exegesis
items.why: This source directly addresses the allegorical interpretation of the figures of Cain and Abel in relation to Israel, making it relevant for the framing of Israel as the greater Cain rejecting the greater Abel. It also connects to themes of sacrifice and can provide insights into the fulfillment of Old Testament themes through Jesus, particularly in the context of sacrifice and creation.
